시편 116:1.content: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

시편 116:2.content: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

시편 116:3.content: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

시편 116:4.content: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

시편 116:5.content: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

시편 116:6.content: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

시편 116:7.content: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

시편 116:8.content: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

시편 116:9.content: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

시편 116:10.content: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

시편 116:11.content: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

시편 116:12.content: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

시편 116:13.content: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

시편 116:14.content: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

시편 116:15.content: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

시편 116:16.content: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

시편 116:17.content: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

시편 116:18.content: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people,

시편 116:19.content: In the courts of the Lord’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
